AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
Patchwork is a to-do list and boards app. The user's to-dos sit in lists that belong to accounts: Nextcloud or other CalDAV servers, Apple Reminders, or storage on the phone. Its functions add a to-do, list the to-dos due today or overdue, list the user's lists, and open the brain dump and voice dictation screens.
Operational patterns: - listTaskLists returns the user's list names. Pass one of them as the list in createTask when the user names a list loosely. - createTask queues the to-do. Patchwork saves it when the app next opens, and its openPatchwork link saves it right away.
Constraints: - listTodayTasks and listTaskLists answer from the last time Patchwork refreshed, given in updatedAt. Changes made in other apps since then are missing. - Dates are calendar days in the phone's time zone.
